---
title: "Florida"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# Load US tracts and filter to Florida
florida_age <- read_rds("us_tracts_age.rds") |>
  filter(str_ends(NAME, "; Florida")) |>
  drop_na(estimate)

# Draw a static map of Florida tracts colored by median age
florida_age |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Median Age") +
  labs(
    title = "Median Age by Census Tract in Florida",
    subtitle = "Central and coastal retirement communities stand out with higher median ages",
    caption = "Source: 2018–2022 5-Year American Community Survey (tidycensus)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 13)
```
